title: Returns Eligibility and Restocking Fee Table — Ridgeline Special Order Services
content:
Returnability after pickup or delivery is a program term of Ridgeline Special Order Services, together with the return window, the packaging condition, the restocking fee and the two restocking waivers.

## Terms of the table

- **Returnable** — whether the item may be returned after pickup or delivery.
- **Return window** — calendar days after pickup or delivery within which a returnable item may be returned.
- **Original packaging required** — whether a return must be unused in the original packaging.
- **Restocking fee** — the restocking fee on a return, as a percentage of the item price.
- **Minimum restocking fee** — the smallest restocking fee when a restocking fee applies, in US dollars.
- **Defective or wrong item waiver** — whether no restocking fee applies when the item is returned as defective or wrong.
- **ProBuild restocking waiver** — whether the Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards restocking waiver applies to returns in the program.

## Table

| Program | Returnable | Return window (days) | Original packaging required | Restocking fee (percent) | Minimum restocking fee (USD) | Defective or wrong item waiver | ProBuild restocking waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | yes | 30 | yes | 15 | 10.00 | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0.00 | yes | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0.00 | yes | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0.00 | yes | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0.00 | yes | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0.00 | yes | no |

## Reading the table

Catalog Merchandise is the only returnable program: a 30-day window, unused in the original packaging, a 15 percent restocking fee with a 10.00 minimum, waived for an item returned as defective or wrong, and open to the ProBuild restocking waiver. The other five programs are not returnable and show a return window of 0 days.
